upstreams.name: recharts
upstreams.note: Tracked release, not a wholesale port. The selected A1–A13 changes and separate B1/B2 guards are recorded below with individual source/verification status. The upstream theme API and unrelated type/dependency changes remain excluded.

selectedReview.verification: Observed local gates, not a full-CI or publication claim: Charts public Node SSR 20/20; selected browser behavior in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit SSR and CSR (server-only claim cases intentionally skip CSR); packed next-core stages passed TS7, TS5.9, distribution and tree-shaking, combined Settings/Charts Node 22/22, and Chromium core 243 passed/5 intentional skips including all charts.spec.ts cases. The composed packed run also completed hydration 1/1, resumed legacy 28/28 and full Select 42/42 on the same fixture. Full CI and publication remain pending.

patches.reason: Upstream registered chart data, layout, axes and series in effects, which do not run on the server, so server HTML had no data geometry. Declarations now seed chart-local state during the first render, identically on the server and during hydration; later changes go through a lazily created native store in Solid's apply phase.

patches.reason: Automatic browser tick measurement could shorten the first hydration list and leave unowned server ticks or gridlines. Axes and default grid generators now claim server-compatible tick lists before enabling automatic measurement in Solid's apply phase. Numeric intervals and custom grid generators retain their behavior.

patches.reason: Upstream rendered layers through a DOM-only Portal, which emits nothing on the server. The layer now renders one owned SVG subtree during SSR and hydration, then moves those nodes into the ordered layer.
